achievements.headline: Demonstrating measurable leadership across landmark international developments

items.description: International leadership experience across the Middle East, North Africa, Europe and East Asia.
Led stakeholder engagement and client relationships for landmark developments, with a combined project value exceeding $5 billion.
Led multidisciplinary teams of architects, engineers, consultants, and specialists from proposal development through construction completion.
Played key management roles in the following projects: One Za'abeel, Tadawul Tower, the Grand Extension of the Al Haram Mosque, the Camp Nou Stadium, and the E-JUST Campus.
Represented Nikken Sekkei in engagements with royal family representatives, government leaders, institutional investors, and major corporate stakeholders.

summary.headline: International project & business management across MENA, Europe and East Asia
paragraphs: I am an experienced professional in international projects and business development, with over 20 years' experience in Japan and overseas. I am a senior project manager who serves as a liaison between Japanese companies and government agencies, as well as private companies in the Middle East, North Africa, Europe and East Asia.

At Nikken Sekkei Ltd., I spearheaded business development initiatives for nearly two decades as a senior project manager on large-scale infrastructure and urban development projects across the aforementioned regions. In this role, I managed projects from start to finish, including planning, proposal development, design, procurement, and site management, as a liaison between Japanese companies and various stakeholders, including overseas governments, royal families, and institutional investors.

The total project value exceeded $5 billion. I was involved in several world-renowned landmark projects, including the One Za’abeel Tower in Dubai, the Tadawul Tower in Riyadh, the E-JUST campus in Alexandria, the expansion of the Grand Mosque’s pilgrimage capacity in Mecca, and the redesign of the Camp Nou stadium in Barcelona.

As a member of the international public relations team, I led overseas public relations activities, including award submissions, corporate publications, project marketing materials, and client inspection tours for senior executives. I also provided comprehensive support for opening multiple overseas offices.

At the risk consulting firm, Tokio Marine & Nichido Risk Consulting Co., Ltd., I worked as a risk intelligence analyst and gained experience producing reports that assessed geopolitical, disaster, security, and political risks in the Middle East and East Asia. I provided strategic reports to Japanese companies and government agencies to help them make decisions about overseas business expansion and market entry. I also supported risk management in their overseas business plans.
